title: Digital Signature Verification Test Cases Companion
description: OpenSSL 3.x verification commands (RSA-2048, ECDSA P-256, Ed25519, detached CMS, OCSP, RFC 3161) plus a pytest suite that executes the tamper-detection, wrong-key, corrupted-signature, empty-document and curve-mismatch cases from the Digital Signature Verification Test Cases resource.
